Hero.subtitle: CORENTIN M.
Hero.title:
Frontend Engineer with
Full-Stack & DevOps Experience
Hero.description: I build responsive, production-ready web applications and contribute across frontend, backend, Docker-based deployments, and CI/CD workflows.

About.title: About Me
About.description1: Full-stack software engineer with hands-on production experience, building web applications from interface to deployment, with a strong focus on frontend integration, APIs, performance, and automation.
About.description2: My work spans Vue.js & Django interfaces, PostgreSQL & Redis optimization, Docker containerization, and GitHub Actions CI/CD. My background in C/C++ system programming (42 School) gives me a proven foundation in algorithms, memory, and performance.

Timeline.title: My Journey
Timeline.subtitle: From intensive training to professional practice.
Timeline.bts_desc: Higher Technician Certificate in Digital Systems - Computing and Networks Option. Network architecture, system, and embedded programming.
Timeline.piscine_desc: Intensive 4-week selection. Introduction to C, Shell, and fundamental programming concepts.
Timeline.school_desc: Intensive learning of C/C++ and system architecture. Realization of complex projects: Minishell (Bash), Cub3D (Graphics engine), Philosophers (Concurrency).
Timeline.arcom_desc: Development and maintenance of a complete After-Sales Service management solution. Optimization of logistic flows, process automation, and creation of intuitive administrative interfaces.

Projects.title: Recent Projects
Projects.subtitle: From production web applications to engineering challenges — each project reflects end-to-end ownership, clean architecture, and real-world deployment.
Projects.arcom_desc: Full-stack development and long-term ownership of a production After-Sales management platform. Django REST backend, Vue.js frontend, PostgreSQL, Docker containerization, and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline. Process automation and role-based admin interfaces.
Projects.portfolio_desc: Personal portfolio built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. Dark mode, i18n (EN/FR), smooth scroll, SEO optimization, and production deployment on Vercel.
Projects.minishell_desc: Faithful reimplementation of a Unix Shell (Bash). Advanced process management, redirections, pipes, and signals.
Projects.cub3d_desc: 3D rendering engine style Wolfenstein 3D created from scratch in C. Physics management, textures, and raycasting.
Projects.philosophers_desc: Simulation of the dining philosophers problem. Complex management of concurrency, threads, mutexes, and deadlock prevention.

Contact.title: Let's Work Together
Contact.description: Open to frontend, full-stack, or DevOps-leaning remote opportunities. Whether you have a role, a question, or just want to connect — I'd love to hear from you.
Contact.success_msg: Thank you for contacting me. I will get back to you as soon as possible.
